strings.text: Only the wind and the trees live here now.
strings.translation: Agora só o vento e as árvores moram aqui.

strings.text: They left for three days. They took only their papers.
strings.translation: Saíram por três dias. Levaram só os documentos.

strings.text: The wheel was meant to start turning on the first of May.
strings.translation: A roda-gigante ia começar a girar no primeiro de maio.

strings.text: The cabins still sway. Only from the wind.
strings.translation: As cabines ainda balançam. Só por causa do vento.
